name: 1-solstice-bay.jpg
caption: Cover — Remy stands large beside the red Solara GT with named crew Marisol and Dex on the boulevard, sun disc and layered art-deco skyline behind live traffic and pedestrians; LOW TIDE objective, Lena Vale dialogue, crew bark, radio chip, full HUD and minimap with waypoint route.

name: 2-air-one-chase.jpg
caption: Four-star pursuit: AIR ONE's rotor-blur disc and searchlight cone hold the NOS-boosting Solara at 84 MPH while three cruisers with flashing lightbars close in; skid marks, four lit stars, AIR ONE chatter, radio and escape waypoint route on the minimap.

name: 3-undertow-docks.jpg
caption: UNDERTOW docks rescue at sunset: Remy, Marisol and Dex approach the tall golden gate beam under gantry-crane silhouettes, container stacks and hill horizon; Crane's crew holds the gate, with mission objective, Marisol dialogue, Dex flank bark and SMG ready.

name: 4-strand-firefight.jpg
caption: BURN NOTICE firefight: Remy and Dex trade crossing tracers and muzzle flashes with three gang members behind a burning wreck and smoke column; teal getaway Solara, three-star wanted HUD, weapon/ammo chip and neon-lit pastel skyline.
